Belong at Gong

Gong is taking action to create genuine, meaningful change in the diverse representation of our workforce, sense of inclusion in our workplace, and equity in our communities. Gongsters are encouraged to join one or many of our Gong Circles - self-organized, employee-run communities focused on advancing a sense of belonging. We are committed to creating visibility, safety, and inclusion for all.


See how this is brought to life in our latest Belonging Report.

Asian @ Gong

The Asian @ Gong Circle provides a safe environment for members to share and reflect on experiences, drives professional development opportunities for Asian people at Gong, and promotes anti-racism within Gong and our communities.

Gente @ Gong

Gong develops a nurturing and empowering community for employees who identify as “Latin” through professional development and social networking activities. By doing so, we hope to create a supportive environment for this community, and increase recruitment, retention, and the promotion of Latin staff.

Proud @ Gong

Proud @ Gong brings together and recognizes LGBTQIA+ employees in a positive and non-judgmental environment leading to a safe work environment for all LGBTQIA+ identifying individuals.

TheNeighborhood @ Gong

TheNeighborhood @ Gong helps shed light on current events and historical milestones impacting Black Gongsters and the broader community. This Circle gives individuals a safe space to talk about internal and external challenges they face, while also allowing members the opportunity to educate fellow Gongsters.

WMN @ Gong

Through our WMN @ Gong efforts, we provide a safe space for professional development, advocacy, and solidarity. This Circle encourages and builds confidence for women at Gong to shatter the glass ceiling both inside and outside of the workplace.

The Village @ Gong

The Village @ Gong provides support and a voice for parents and caregivers to help strike harmony between work and family life. This virtual village provides a safe space to talk about internal and external challenges faced within our communities and develop programs to support all types of family dynamics.

Big goals deserve great benefits

Great work starts with people who are supported to thrive - in work and in life. That’s why we invest in benefits that help you stay healthy, grow your career, and show up at your best every day.

Culture & community
  • Belong and be you 
    Join employee communities that celebrate different perspectives and create a strong sense of belonging.
  • Moments that matter 
    From team events to global gatherings, we create space to connect, celebrate, and have fun.
  • Make an impact 
    Support the causes you care about with opportunities to give back and make a difference.
Health & wellbeing
  • Thrive at your best 
    We offer comprehensive health coverage for you and your family, with plans designed to support real life—wherever you are in the world.
  • Global recharge days 
    We hit pause together with company-wide days off to fully disconnect and come back stronger.
  • Mental health, prioritized 
    Your mental wellbeing matters. Get access to confidential support, coaching, and resources when you need it—no stigma, no barriers.
  • Wellbeing, your way 
    Use flexible wellbeing support to invest in what keeps you feeling strong—whether that’s fitness, mindfulness, or something in between.
Financial & future planning
  • Invest in your future 
    We support your long-term financial goals with locally relevant retirement or pension programs—so you can plan ahead with confidence.
  • Own what you build 
    We believe in shared success. Equity opportunities give you a real stake in Gong’s growth.
  • Protection that matters 
    Life happens. We provide coverage that helps protect you and your loved ones when it matters most.
Family & life
  • Support for every family 
    Take meaningful time to be with your family through paid parental leave designed to support all parents.
  • Build your family, your way 
    We offer support for different paths to parenthood, including fertility, adoption, and more.
  • Help beyond work 
    From caregiving to legal and financial guidance, you’ll have access to resources that help you navigate life outside of work.
Growth & Development
  • Keep getting better 
    We invest in your growth with learning opportunities, training, and development resources to help you level up.
  • Learn without limits 
    Take advantage of programs and support designed to help you expand your skills and career.
